holidays.name: Answer the Telephone Like Buddy the Elf Day
holidays.description: Pick up every call today with the breathless, bubbly cheer of Buddy the Elf from the 2003 film Elf. Your best move is to open with Buddy's famous greeting: 'Buddy the Elf, what's your favorite color?' Expect confused callers and a few delighted ones.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial pop-culture observance. It was inspired by the 2003 Christmas comedy Elf, in which Will Ferrell's Buddy answers the phone with an enthusiastic greeting at the department store where he works.
holidays.funFact: Will Ferrell's Buddy is raised at the North Pole, and the film's elf-sized sets were built with forced-perspective camera tricks. Those tricks make Buddy look huge next to the other elves without any digital effects.

holidays.name: Wear a Plunger on Your Head Day
holidays.description: A gloriously silly day that asks you to put a rubber plunger on your head and walk proudly into the world. It is not recommended for use with a plunger that has seen action. Wear it to work, to the grocery store, or on a video call to confirm that your coworkers are still paying attention.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It is a celebration of pure, harmless absurdity that spreads through humorous holiday lists each December.
holidays.funFact: The modern cup-shaped plunger is a surprisingly old invention. Variations of the design date to the 1800s, and it has barely changed since. It remains one of the few tools whose design is considered essentially perfect.
